# Passwords4Free — AI Crawler Context File
# https://llmstxt.org

## Site identity
Name: Passwords4Free
URL: https://passwords-4-free.com
Description: Passwords4Free is a free, privacy-first website to generate strong random passwords and check how secure a password is, entirely in your browser using the Web Crypto API — nothing you type is ever sent or stored. It also publishes friendly, practical password and online-safety guides.
